name: nexus-reminder
description: Nexus — a voice-driven, 3D to-do list and reminder system

scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace web run build && node scripts/inject-sw-assets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:nlp && npm run test:recognition && npm run test:handwriting && npm run test:alarms && npm run test:offline && npm run test:planner
scripts.build:demo: VITE_DEMO=true VITE_BASE=${VITE_BASE:-/reminder/} npm --workspace web run build && node scripts/inject-sw-assets.mjs && cp web/dist/index.html web/dist/404.html
scripts.preview:demo: npm run build:demo && npx --yes serve -s web/dist -l 4173
scripts.build:mobile: node scripts/install-alarm-sounds.mjs && VITE_NATIVE=true VITE_BASE=/ npm --workspace web run build
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:mobile && npm --workspace web exec cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npm --workspace web exec cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npm --workspace web exec cap open ios
scripts.mobile:run:android: npm run mobile:sync && npm --workspace web exec cap run android
